page_title: KOL 2-0 EIN | FC Koln v Eintracht Frankfurt 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+3' Excellent touch by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
90+2' 13:11 – the total goal attempt statistics. 3:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Denis Huseinbasic walks off the pitch and Jacob Christensen (1. FC Koln) comes on as a substitute.
89' Timo Schultz prepares a substitution. Max Finkgrafe is replaced by Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln).
89' Substitution. Benno Schmitz did his best and is replaced by Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln).
88' A pass from Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by Kevin Trapp and the move breaks down.
86' Neat passing move from FC Koln in order to create new attacking opportunities.
84' The attendance for today's match is 50000.
83' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
83' Corner kick. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to send the ball into the box.
81' Timo Gerach blows his whistle. Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) commits a foul after dangerous play.
80' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Dejan Ljubicic tees up Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Kevin Trapp.
79' Here comes a substitution. Florian Kainz is given a rest as he is replaced by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
79' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
77' A substitution has been made. Sasa Kalajdzic is replaced by Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Ansgar Knauff.
77' Substitution. Sebastian Rode (Eintracht Frankfurt) on for Mario Gotze.
75' Sasa Kalajdzic (Eintracht Frankfurt) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
75' Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

75' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Marvin Schwabe anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.
73' Substitution. Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) has come on for Faride Alidou.
72' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
72' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, FC Koln are going to take it.
71' Dangerous play by Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt). Timo Gerach blows his whistle for a foul.
69' Here is a change. Hugo Larsson is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt).
68' 1 - 0 Goal! Dejan Ljubicic takes aim and his effort deflects off Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) to beat the goalkeeper. 1:0.
66' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
66' Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Timo Gerach blows his whistle for an infringement.
64' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Timo Gerach blows for a foul.
63' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

63' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
60' The resulting corner from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
58' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
57' Eintracht Frankfurt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
55' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) has tested the patience of referee Timo Gerach and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

54' A clever short pass gives Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
54' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the corner.
53' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
53' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.

52' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) hits a dangerous effort towards the top right corner from the promising free kick. His shot is stopped by a well prepared Marvin Schwabe. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a corner.
51' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
49' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
46' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
46' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Fares Chaibi comes on the pitch for Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Timo Gerach has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45' What an opportunity! Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
44' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Timo Gerach has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
43' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
43' The current number of corner kicks is 3:3.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.

40' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Marvin Schwabe is alert and denies him. Eintracht Frankfurt get a corner.

39' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
36' The referee blows his whistle as Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in his challenge.
34' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
33' Flag goes up against Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
33' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

32' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The ball goes out for a corner. FC Koln can continue in their attacking effort.

32' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' The Eintracht Frankfurt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
29' A crossfield pass from Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) fails to find any of his teammates.

28' Mario Gotze floats a good corner into the box that Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
28' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
28' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

27' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
25' Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a strong challenge and Timo Gerach blows for a foul.
22' Sasa Kalajdzic (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Timo Gerach blows for a foul.
19' Yellow card. Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
18' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' It looks like Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) saw red with that tackle. Timo Gerach won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
15' The corner is swung in but FC Koln can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

15' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the right post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to FC Koln.
13' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Timo Gerach no option but to blow his whistle.
9' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
3' Great teamplay by FC Koln as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is caught offside!

The players are out at last! Eintracht Frankfurt will take the kick-off.
